options.name: comment
options.description: Configures a text string comment to be associated with the instance of this object.  The provided text string will be configured on the object instance. Maximum 256 characters.

options.name: extattrs
options.description: Allows for the configuration of Extensible Attributes on the instance of the object.  This argument accepts a set of key / value pairs for configuration.

options.name: ipv4addr
options.description: The IPv4 Address of the record. Mutually exclusive with the ipv6addr.

options.name: ipv6addr
options.description: The IPv6 Address of the record. Mutually exclusive with the ipv4addr.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the DNS PTR record in FQDN format to add or remove from the system. The field is required only for an PTR object in Forward Mapping Zone.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: ptrdname
options.description: The domain name of the DNS PTR record in FQDN format.

options.name: state
options.description: Configures the intended state of the instance of the object on the NIOS server.  When this value is set to C(present), the object is configured on the device and when this value is set to C(absent) the value is removed (if necessary) from the device.

options.name: ttl
options.description: Time To Live (TTL) value for the record. A 32-bit unsigned integer that represents the duration, in seconds, that the record is valid (cached). Zero indicates that the record should not be cached.

options.name: view
options.description: Sets the DNS view to associate this a record with. The DNS view must already be configured on the system.
